hook: In Indonesia, a small fault on a motorbike or a water pump can cost a day's wage. Repair videos can't see your problem, and most of them aren't in your language.
intro: Take a photo and say what's wrong. This run is in demo mode, with AI-generated sample photos.
progress: Each stage shows its result as soon as it finishes: what Muse Spark saw, the parts SAM 3.1 outlined, then the likely cause.
question: When the evidence is ambiguous, it asks one short question instead of guessing.
diagnosis: Then the diagnosis: likely causes with confidence, a safety level, tools, time, and the parts cost next to the repair-shop price.
parts: SAM 3.1 masks and numbers the parts on your own photo, not on a generic diagram.
preflight: Before step one there's a short safety checklist. The steps stay locked until every item is ticked.
live: The live camera guide: point the phone and SAM 3.1 outlines the part to touch, about once a second. Here the camera is Chromium's fake camera playing a sample photo.
check_fail: After each step, Check my step. Muse Spark compares the photo with the expected state. This one is too dark, so it asks for the torch instead of guessing.
check_pass: Retake it, and the step is verified before you move on.
handsfree: Hands dirty? Turn on hands-free. Each step is read aloud, and the phone listens for lanjut, ulang or cek.
replan: Still broken? Say what happened, and it re-plans to the next most likely cause. Plan, act, verify, re-plan.
diagram: When a photo can't show a step, Muse Image draws a diagram and Muse Spark checks it. In demo mode the drawing is a placeholder.
agent: Every decision is on screen: what it saw, why it asked, each photo check, each re-plan, and which Meta model did it.
handoff: When it's a job for a pro, one tap hands it off: a WhatsApp summary of what was found and tried, a search for the nearest bengkel, and a PDF brief for the mechanic.
rice: It also knows when to say no. Fixing a rice cooker that won't heat means opening 220 volt internals, so the safety gate stops the guide.
wa: It works in WhatsApp too, in Javanese. Send a photo and the same agent replies with the marked photo, the diagnosis and a button for each step. A gas leak still gets a red stop.
ow: With one switch, diagnosis and planning run on Muse Spark Open, Meta's open-weights model, on Baseten. The app shows a badge when it does.
arch: Under the hood: Voice Transcribe, Muse Spark to see, reason and check, SAM 3.1 for masks and live tracking, and Muse Image for diagrams. The safety rules are enforced in code.
close: Tukang Copilot. Every phone becomes a mechanic's apprentice.
